dataSource.query:
AIQSnapshotRunsV1(_startTime, _endTime, 'swedencentral', 'unique-issues-noise-1-duplicate-05-miss-025-v2')
| project Value = FrameworkRunId, Label = strcat(format_datetime(ReportDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), ' / ', FrameworkRunId), ReportDate
| order by ReportDate desc
| project Value, Label

tiles.query:
let Latest = materialize(AIQSnapshotRunsV1(_startTime, _endTime, 'swedencentral', 'unique-issues-noise-1-duplicate-05-miss-025-v2')
| sort by ReportDate desc, SnapshotOrder desc
| take 1);
union
(Latest | project ReportDate, QualityScore, C_E = strcat(CorrectIssues, '/', ExpectedIssues), M = MissedIssues, N = NoiseCards, D = DuplicateCards, ExcludedUnits, Publication = 'Published'),
(print ReportDate = datetime(null), QualityScore = real(null), C_E = '', M = long(null), N = long(null), D = long(null), ExcludedUnits = long(null), Publication = 'No official public-safe v2 publications in Sweden Central for these dates. Select another range; never publish private TEST data to populate this dashboard.'
| where toscalar(Latest | count) == 0)
tiles.title: Latest stored v2 quality — C/E detected/scored; M misses; N Noise; D Duplicates

tiles.query:
AIQSnapshotRunsV1(_startTime, _endTime, 'swedencentral', 'unique-issues-noise-1-duplicate-05-miss-025-v2')
| extend Series = strcat('v2 / Sweden Central / ', CoveragePolicy)
| project ReportDate, QualityScore, Series
| order by ReportDate asc
tiles.title: Stored v2 quality trend — Sweden Central; check coverage and rotation limits below

tiles.query:
let Latest = materialize(AIQSnapshotChangesV1(_startTime, _endTime, 'swedencentral', 'unique-issues-noise-1-duplicate-05-miss-025-v2')
| sort by ReportDate desc, SnapshotOrder desc
| take 1);
union
(Latest | project Metric = 'C — detected issues', Previous = PreviousCorrect, Current = CorrectIssues, Change = DeltaCorrect, PreviousWeighted = real(null), CurrentWeighted = real(null)),
(Latest | project Metric = 'M — missed scored issues', Previous = PreviousMissed, Current = MissedIssues, Change = DeltaMissed, PreviousWeighted = PreviousWeightedMisses, CurrentWeighted = WeightedMisses),
(Latest | project Metric = 'N — Noise cards', Previous = PreviousNoise, Current = NoiseCards, Change = DeltaNoise, PreviousWeighted = PreviousWeightedNoise, CurrentWeighted = WeightedNoise),
(Latest | project Metric = 'D — Duplicate cards', Previous = PreviousDuplicates, Current = DuplicateCards, Change = DeltaDuplicates, PreviousWeighted = PreviousWeightedDuplicates, CurrentWeighted = WeightedDuplicates)
| extend WeightedChange = CurrentWeighted - PreviousWeighted
| order by Metric asc
tiles.title: Latest vs previous snapshot — count changes and denominator penalties, not causal attribution

tiles.query:
AIQSnapshotChangesV1(_startTime, _endTime, 'swedencentral', 'unique-issues-noise-1-duplicate-05-miss-025-v2')
| project ReportDate, PreviousDate, IssueCoverage = strcat(ScoredIssues, '/', PlannedIssues), PreviousIssues = iff(isempty(PreviousRunId), '', strcat(PreviousScoredIssues, '/', PreviousPlannedIssues)), BaselineCoverage = strcat(ScoredBaselines, '/', PlannedBaselines), PreviousBaselines = iff(isempty(PreviousRunId), '', strcat(PreviousScoredBaselines, '/', PreviousPlannedBaselines)), ExcludedUnits, PreviousExcluded, ComparisonNote
| order by ReportDate desc
tiles.title: Coverage and comparison limits — scored/planned units; excluded units are not misses
Agent counts — current and previous snapshots; baselines add penalties, not a score bonus
Which units changed? — blank counts/deltas mean excluded, not planned, or no previous snapshot

tiles.query:
let SelectedRun = toscalar(AIQSnapshotRunsV1(_startTime, _endTime, 'swedencentral', 'unique-issues-noise-1-duplicate-05-miss-025-v2')
| where isempty(_snapshot) or FrameworkRunId == _snapshot
| sort by ReportDate desc, SnapshotOrder desc
| take 1
| project FrameworkRunId);
AIQFindingsV1(pack_array(SelectedRun))
| where isempty(_currentAgent) or Agent == _currentAgent
| summarize Cards = count() by Agent, LogicalVersion, Kind, Scored, Classification, ExclusionReasons = tostring(ExclusionReasons)
| order by Scored asc, Agent asc, LogicalVersion asc, Classification asc
tiles.title: Finding counts — scored and unscored stay separate; unexpected real findings are not Noise

tiles.query:
let Selected = materialize(AIQSnapshotChangesV1(_startTime, _endTime, 'swedencentral', 'unique-issues-noise-1-duplicate-05-miss-025-v2')
| where isempty(_snapshot) or FrameworkRunId == _snapshot
| sort by ReportDate desc, SnapshotOrder desc
| take 1);
union
(Selected | project ReportDate, PreviousDate, ComparisonNote, Metadata = bag_pack('FrameworkRunId', FrameworkRunId, 'PreviousRunId', PreviousRunId, 'SourceCommit', SourceCommit, 'PreviousSourceCommit', PreviousSourceCommit, 'Region', Region, 'ScoringPolicy', ScoringPolicy, 'ScoreFormula', ScoreFormula, 'NoiseWeight', NoiseWeight, 'DuplicateWeight', DuplicateWeight, 'MissWeight', MissWeight, 'CoveragePolicy', CoveragePolicy)),
(print ReportDate = datetime(null), PreviousDate = datetime(null), ComparisonNote = 'No official public-safe v2 snapshot in Sweden Central matches these filters. Select All (latest) or another date range. Private TEST results are never published here.', Metadata = dynamic(null)
| where toscalar(Selected | count) == 0)
tiles.title: Selected snapshot and comparison limits — expand Metadata for source and recorded policy
